observations.body: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders ascend, see the God of Israel with sapphire-like pavement under his feet, and eat and drink without being struck.
observations.label: Representatives see Israel’s God and eat and drink

observations.body: Representatives see Israel’s God and eat and drink belongs to covenant sealed in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 24:9–11 supplies core evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Covenant sealing and representative ascent follow the public words without granting the entire assembly the same access.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 24:9–11 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Representatives see Israel’s God and eat and drink belongs to the covenant sealed movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: Representatives see Israel’s God and eat and drink
